info.description: One entry per page of the website. Holds that page's SEO metadata and its editable text content.

pageKey.description: Stable ID the website looks this page up by. Do NOT change once set. One of: home, about, portfolio, contact, faq, privacy, terms, blog.

title.description: Internal label, shown in this list only. Not published.

slug.description: URL path this page lives at, e.g. /about

seo.description: Search-engine and social-sharing metadata for this page.
